spanish: Y su comediente su iniquidad llevará, porque santidad de Jehová profanó, y será cortada el alma aquella desde sus pueblos.

findings.issue: Qal active participle is masculine plural construct with a 3ms suffix (those who eat it). Singular comediente changes that number.

notes: The rest matches the tokens: 3ms imperfect, כי, construct קדש plus Jehová, piel perfect, niphal 3fs, definite נפש, feminine demonstrative, and plural peoples with a 3fs suffix.
